fields.description: Timestamp of the last successful BigQuery sync for this student. Used to detect stale records.
fields.label: Last Synced At

fields.description: What the student said when they clicked the problem button in the WhatsApp flow. Stored in Glific as sp_submission_link. Often empty or an emoji for escalated students. When non-empty and meaningful, Didi opens by acknowledging this specific blocker.
fields.label: Problem Reported

fields.description: Whether the WhatsApp flow broke mid-way without the student completing it. Set by the Glific flow as last_flow_incomplete.
fields.label: Last Flow Incomplete

fields.description: The exact assignment name the student was working on when they last interacted with the flow. Set by Glific as SP_assigment_id. Often null for escalated students who dropped before reaching the assignment node. Fall back to course name when null.
fields.label: Last Assignment Name

fields.description: Body of the student's most recent inbound WhatsApp message. Synced from BigQuery messages table. Useful for Didi to reference what the student last said.
fields.label: Last Inbound Message

fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent inbound message from the student.
fields.label: Last Inbound At

fields.description: Full raw_fields JSON snapshot from BigQuery contacts table. Kept for debugging and adding new fields without schema changes. Do not rely on this field in code; extract specific fields above.
fields.label: Raw Glific Fields
